plugin_desc: RubyTech managed Ethernet switch SNMP collection (IANA PEN 5205). Interface traffic is supplied by the shared Switch SNMP IF-MIB floor. CPU utilization uses model-branch selection by sysObjectID and does not mix model branches: FGS2924R (sysObjectID 1.3.6.1.4.1.5205.2.34) parses fgs2924rCpuLoad DisplayString percent text to cpu_usage_percent; ES2226 (sysObjectID 1.3.6.1.4.1.5205.2.31) parses es2226CPULoad to cpu_usage_percent. RamSize leaves are RAM capacity only and are not treated as memory usage. Temperature, fan and power-supply state are not collected. Supported brands/models — RubyTech FGS2924R and ES2226.
name: Switch

metrics.name: cpu_usage_percent
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the RubyTech switch control plane as a 0-100 percentage. Model-branch selection by sysObjectID chooses FGS2924R fgs2924rCpuLoad or ES2226 es2226CPULoad; DisplayString percent text is parsed to cpu_usage_percent. The two model branches are not mixed. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload and may lead to slow management response or packet processing delays.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the RubyTech switch control plane as a 0-100 percentage, sourced from cpu_usage_percent after model-branch selection by sysObjectID. RamSize is not used. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload and may lead to slow management response or packet processing delays.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
